== Biography ==
John Glasgow was born about 1830 at Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, Scotland, son of [[Glasgow-1578|John Glasgow]] and [[Gemmill-363|Janet (Gemmill) Glasgow]].<ref name="Ancestry1851Kilmarnock">"Scotland Census 1851," database and images, Ancestry. Kilmarnock parish 597, Enumeration District 4, page 11, schedule 44, line 6, roll CSSCT1851_133. Household at Mitchells Land lists John 60, Janet 55, Alexander 45, John 21, Isabella 20, Janet 11, Margaret 10. John 21 recorded as flesher. Accessed 23 Sep 2025. Record: [https://www.ancestry.co.uk/discoveryui-content/view/1657334:1076 Ancestry item 1657334].</ref>

* '''Address''': Mitchells Land, town Kilmarnock, county Ayrshire. Recorded on the 1851 Scotland census for the parental household.<ref name="Ancestry1851Kilmarnock" />
